name: Southeastern Vietnam
climate: Hot year-round. Drier from about December to April. Wet-season rain often arrives as a heavy afternoon shower.
days: 3 days in the city, plus a day trip to Cu Chi or the delta.
summary: Vietnam’s largest city, the usual end of a north-to-south trip, with day trips to Cu Chi and the Mekong.
body: Ho Chi Minh City is the commercial capital. The walkable core is District 1, around the Opera House, Dong Khoi, and Ben Thanh Market. The war-history sites and the Chinese-influenced streets of Cholon need a deliberate plan, not a leftover hour.

The 2025 merger folded neighboring provinces into the city on paper. Travelers still book Vung Tau, Cu Chi, and the delta as separate journeys. Cu Chi is a half day. The delta wants a full day or a night in Can Tho.
seoDescription: What to do with three days in Ho Chi Minh City, and which day trips are actually worth the ride.
